AppliesScope.description:
Half-open [start, end) applicability on the ingestion-receipt axis
— the axis TS-001 queries are historically closed over. The boundary
instant belongs to the successor.
AppliesScope.title: AppliesScope

AssertionSummary.description:
Structured evidence: enough to explain a resolution — including the
exact closure, supersession, and retraction records — without
searching the revision.
AssertionSummary.title: AssertionSummary

BehaviorAnchor.description:
One stable behavior identity and no behavioral claim.

Participants, rule family, context, lifecycle, evidence, direction, and
every operational meaning belong to model-ledger records, never to this
opaque identity. Human-facing names may change without changing the
referent named by ``anchor_id``.
BehaviorAnchor.title: BehaviorAnchor

BehaviorRegistration.description:
Permanent evidence-backed registration of one unordered variable pair.

Registration has no context and no lifecycle. Changing a participant or
rule family requires a new behavior anchor and registration.
BehaviorRegistration.title: BehaviorRegistration

BehaviorRuleDeclaration.description:
Correctable exact-context BH-001 equality declaration.

Participant order is non-semantic. The declaration has no direction,
role, tolerance, computed outcome, port, VPA, or operational meaning.
BehaviorRuleDeclaration.title: BehaviorRuleDeclaration

BehaviorRuleWithdrawal.description: Membership-relative retraction of one current BHD tip only.
BehaviorRuleWithdrawal.title: BehaviorRuleWithdrawal

BehaviorVariableSemanticLock.description:
Declared exact semantic identity expected for one participant.

The lock neither creates nor replaces variable specifications or semantic
declarations. Those independent model/source findings are evaluated only
by the separately owner-gated upper layer.
BehaviorVariableSemanticLock.title: BehaviorVariableSemanticLock

BindingRevision.description:
Exact, reconstructable membership. `revision_id` names both the
authoritative set and its membership; canonical order is the sorted
record ids — never filesystem enumeration or recorded_at order.
BindingRevision.title: BindingRevision

CandidateObservation.description:
One queried locator: its declarative discovery context (verbatim
from identity_binding — never copied, truncated, reinterpreted, or
reconstructed here), the bound temporal result (verbatim), and the
per-candidate attachment verdict.
CandidateObservation.title: CandidateObservation

interpreted_unit_source_lexeme_not_evalu.title: Interpreted Unit Source Lexeme Not Evaluated Reason

ConstraintAnchor.description:
One canonical constraint identity. A constraint claims exactly one
thing — this ID names one particular constraint — and nothing else: no
target variable, no unit, no predicate, no severity. The target-variable
association is a permanent membership claim carried by a
``ConstraintRegistration`` record, never by the anchor, so it cannot
become an unsupported model fact when the declaration is superseded. IDs
are opaque (uuid4 hex); ``namespace``, ``display_name``, and
``role_name`` are human context and are never used for matching.

Unlike the older ``EntityAnchor``/``VariableAnchor`` (whose behaviour is
unchanged), the constraint anchor re-validates any instance handed back
through ``model_validate``, so a ``model_construct`` forgery (a bad id,
namespace, or empty display name) is caught here rather than silently
accepted — the accepted construction-forgery discipline (acceptance row
A6). This applies only to this anchor; it carries no storage, I/O, or
authority.
ConstraintAnchor.title: ConstraintAnchor

ConstraintRegistration.description:
PERMANENT, evidence-bearing membership claim: one constraint identity
(``con_`` anchor) targets one variable. Unlike entity/variable
registrations (membership-only envelopes), a constraint registration
carries nonempty ``EvidenceRef`` evidence, canonicalized by the uniform
rules. It has NO ``supersedes``, withdrawal, or lifecycle field: the
target-variable association must not become an unsupported model fact
when a later declaration is superseded. The complete ``ConstraintAnchor``
is embedded; the target variable is referenced by id, never embedded.
ConstraintRegistration.title: ConstraintRegistration

DeclaredBindingSummary.description:
One property-binding assertion, summarized declaratively for
reverse discovery. Deliberately TIME-FREE: `lifecycle_flags` states
which lifecycle events this binding revision records (sorted, unique;
an empty tuple means no supersession, retraction, or closure is
recorded — NEVER "currently applicable"). Applicability at an
observation is decided solely by forward resolution at that
occurrence's own received_at.
DeclaredBindingSummary.title: DeclaredBindingSummary

DeclaredLocatorEntry.description:
One source locator with ALL property assertions declared on it —
any target — so a shared locator explains its own conflicts
standalone.
DeclaredLocatorEntry.title: DeclaredLocatorEntry

EntityAnchor.description:
One canonical entity identity. `referent_kind` classifies only what
kind of referent the ID names — an installed unit is never the same
anchor as its CAD/type definition; the relation between them belongs
to the future kernel.
EntityAnchor.title: EntityAnchor

EntityRegistration.description:
Membership claim for one already-declared canonical identity. NO
lifecycle: the kernel provides no supersession, no withdrawal, and no
path that alters any embedded anchor field.
EntityRegistration.title: EntityRegistration

ExactNumericEqualityRule.description: The complete BH-001 v1 rule body: exact equality and nothing else.
ExactNumericEqualityRule.title: ExactNumericEqualityRule

FlowAnchor.description:
One stable logical directed flow identity and no flow claim.

Permanent source/sink port sets and nominal flow kind belong to one
separately admitted model registration. Topology/interface support,
context, declaration lifecycle, activity, observation, occurrence,
mechanism, rate, conservation, and causal meaning never belong to this
opaque identity. Names are human context and never identity material.
FlowAnchor.title: FlowAnchor

FlowDeclaration.description: Correctable exact-context flow capability with exact PCN/PIF pins.
FlowDeclaration.title: FlowDeclaration

FlowDeclarationWithdrawal.description: Membership-relative retraction of one current FLD tip only.
FlowDeclarationWithdrawal.title: FlowDeclarationWithdrawal

FlowDirectionDeclarationPin.description:
Exact port and direction-role PIF identity; role is supplied by the
containing declaration field.
FlowDirectionDeclarationPin.title: FlowDirectionDeclarationPin

FlowKindToken.description: Exact nominal identity of one logical flow kind; no ontology.
FlowKindToken.title: FlowKindToken

FlowMeasurementAssociation.description: One exact, evidence-backed direct-measurement relevance claim.
FlowMeasurementAssociation.title: FlowMeasurementAssociation

FlowMeasurementAssociationWithdrawal.description: Uncitable membership-relative withdrawal of one eligible FMA tip.
FlowMeasurementAssociationWithdrawal.title: FlowMeasurementAssociationWithdrawal

FlowOperatingCriterionDeclaration.description: Authority designation of an exact constraint edition for an FM witness.
FlowOperatingCriterionDeclaration.title: FlowOperatingCriterionDeclaration

FlowOperatingCriterionWithdrawal.description: Uncitable withdrawal of one retained positive FC designation.
FlowOperatingCriterionWithdrawal.title: FlowOperatingCriterionWithdrawal

FlowRegistration.description: Permanent logical directed port-group and nominal-kind identity.
FlowRegistration.title: FlowRegistration

InterfaceDomainToken.description: Exact interface-domain identity token; no ontology is implied.
InterfaceDomainToken.title: InterfaceDomainToken

InterfaceTypeToken.description: Exact interface-type identity token; no compatibility is implied.
InterfaceTypeToken.title: InterfaceTypeToken

InterpretationRevision.description: Exact set identity and sorted, reconstructable record membership.
InterpretationRevision.title: InterpretationRevision

ModelRevision.description:
COMPUTED ONLY — never a file, never a ledger record; the membership
pattern structurally excludes mrv_. Canonical order is the sorted
record ids, never filesystem enumeration.
ModelRevision.title: ModelRevision

MonotonicTimeMarker.description:
A source-native monotonic clock reading, kept as the exact number
lexeme — explicitly NOT a wall-clock time and never converted.
MonotonicTimeMarker.title: MonotonicTimeMarker

ObservationRoleReference.description: Exact identity token for an observation role, never behaviour.
ObservationRoleReference.title: ObservationRoleReference

OwnerDeclarationEvidence.description:
The claim's basis is a human decision, honestly labeled as such —
the only prose-bearing evidence kind.
OwnerDeclarationEvidence.title: OwnerDeclarationEvidence

PortAnchor.description: One stable port identity and no interface or topology claim.
PortAnchor.title: PortAnchor

QuantityKindReference.description: Exact identity token for a quantity kind, never an ontology.
QuantityKindReference.title: QuantityKindReference

RelationshipAssertion.description:
One directed, typed, evidence-backed edge claim, judged by the EXACT
definition it cites.
RelationshipAssertion.title: RelationshipAssertion

RelationshipTypeDefinition.description:
One member of a type LINEAGE named by its invariant type_name.
Supersession preserves {type_name, directionality, hierarchy_semantics,
context_requirement}; changing any of these requires a new type name.
RelationshipTypeDefinition.title: RelationshipTypeDefinition

RelationshipWithdrawal.description:
"No longer asserted" — never a claim the original was wrong, and
never a claim about when it stopped being true.
RelationshipWithdrawal.title: RelationshipWithdrawal

SourceSelector.description:
An explicit locator to inspect through the accepted forward
pipeline. Selecting never creates or implies a binding.
SourceSelector.title: SourceSelector

SourceSubjectRef.description: Unresolved source-native subject identity — NOT a system entity.
SourceSubjectRef.title: SourceSubjectRef

StateAnchor.description:
One stable state identity and no state-region or runtime claim.

Subject entity, permanent constraints, context, evidence, lifecycle, and
every classification or transition meaning belong to separately admitted
model records. Names are human context and never identity material.
StateAnchor.title: StateAnchor

StateConstraintDeclarationPin.description: Exact VCN identity pinned for one permanent state condition.
StateConstraintDeclarationPin.title: StateConstraintDeclarationPin

StateDeclaration.description: Correctable exact-context declaration of one registered state region.
StateDeclaration.title: StateDeclaration

StateDeclarationWithdrawal.description: Membership-relative retraction of one current STD tip only.
StateDeclarationWithdrawal.title: StateDeclarationWithdrawal

StateRegistration.description: Permanent evidence-backed identity of one entity-scoped state region.
StateRegistration.title: StateRegistration

StructuralSourceLocatorEvidence.description:
An EXACT structural position inside one immutable source payload,
declared by the authoring authority (SN-001, ADR-0010 decision 10).

SELF-CONTAINED: every field is a canonical scalar. The kernel imports
nothing to interpret it, resolves nothing, and verifies nothing about
it — disclosure is always verification="declared_reference", because
the kernel structurally cannot import data_sources. This is a
CITATION, never a locator ledger and never an identity: it names
where a claim was read, not what the claim is about. It has no
lifecycle and no applicability, cannot resolve source identity, and
cannot discover or replace a BindingAssertion. The toolchain
fingerprint makes a STEP locator exact: an OCAF path exists only
relative to a toolchain.
StructuralSourceLocatorEvidence.title: StructuralSourceLocatorEvidence

SubjectResolutionContext.description:
Non-recursive subject context on property results: statuses,
anchors, and assertion ids only — never a nested ResolutionResult.
SubjectResolutionContext.title: SubjectResolutionContext

TemporalOccurrence.description:
Immutable point fact: this value was observed at this occurrence.
Never proof the value stayed true until the next poll.
TemporalOccurrence.title: TemporalOccurrence

TransitionAnchor.description:
One stable transition identity and no transition meaning.

Subject entity, ordered endpoint states, exact endpoint declarations,
context, evidence, and lifecycle belong to separately admitted model-ledger
records. Assessment and occurrence are deferred and absent. Names are
human context and never identity material.
TransitionAnchor.title: TransitionAnchor

TransitionDeclaration.description: Correctable exact-context declaration with exact endpoint STD pins.
TransitionDeclaration.title: TransitionDeclaration

TransitionDeclarationWithdrawal.description: Membership-relative retraction of one current TRD tip only.
TransitionDeclarationWithdrawal.title: TransitionDeclarationWithdrawal

TransitionRegistration.description: Permanent same-subject directed endpoint transition identity.
TransitionRegistration.title: TransitionRegistration

TransitionStateDeclarationPin.description:
Exact endpoint StateAnchor and STD identities; role is supplied by
the containing declaration field.
TransitionStateDeclarationPin.title: TransitionStateDeclarationPin

UnboundedBoundary.description: An explicit authority claim — not the absence of knowledge.
UnboundedBoundary.title: UnboundedBoundary

UnitNotDeclared.description:
The model declares no unit for this variable — an explicit claim,
distinct from a source that supplied no unit.
UnitNotDeclared.title: UnitNotDeclared

UnitReference.description:
An identity TOKEN for a unit, never a unit definition. It asserts no
dimension, convertibility, scale or offset, SI traceability, or
equivalence to any external standard. Identity is the exact triple
(system_id, system_edition, code), compared byte-for-byte.
UnitReference.title: UnitReference

UnknownBoundary.description: Absence of knowledge — never equivalent to unbounded.
UnknownBoundary.title: UnknownBoundary

VariableAnchor.description:
One canonical variable of one entity. Ownership is identity, not
hierarchy; the anchor never carries units, datatypes, or meaning the
source did not supply.
VariableAnchor.title: VariableAnchor

VariableConstraintDeclaration.description:
The correctable numeric constraint claim. Its LINEAGE KEY is the
``con_`` anchor only. Predicate form, boundaries, inclusivity, and all
expected semantic tokens may change under a correction. The permanent
registration owns the target variable. Locks are intentionally not
cross-validated against VSM/VSP at append; mismatch belongs to Slice B.
VariableConstraintDeclaration.title: VariableConstraintDeclaration

VariablePortAssociation.description:
A positive, evidence-backed variable-to-port association claim.

Endpoint registration and exact same-owner admission are collection
invariants, not duplicated fields. The claim says nothing about an
observation at a port, transport, flow, topology, compatibility,
behaviour, control, causality, correctness, or safety.
VariablePortAssociation.title: VariablePortAssociation

VariablePortAssociationWithdrawal.description: Membership-relative retraction of one positive VPA claim.
VariablePortAssociationWithdrawal.title: VariablePortAssociationWithdrawal

VariableRegistration.description:
Membership claim for one already-declared canonical VARIABLE of a
registered entity. Ownership is identity (`anchor.entity_anchor_id`),
never a relationship edge; like entity registrations there is NO
lifecycle and no kernel correction path. Membership only — no state,
no units, no datatype, no meaning.
VariableRegistration.title: VariableRegistration

VariableSemanticDeclaration.description: One authority claim about one dimension of model-side meaning.
VariableSemanticDeclaration.title: VariableSemanticDeclaration

VariableSpecificationResult.description:
The SINGLE source of specification status. `conflicted` carries every
competing current tip verbatim and is never resolved by recency,
authority, record id, file order, or append order.
VariableSpecificationResult.title: VariableSpecificationResult

VariableValueSpecification.description:
What the MODEL requires this variable's value representation to be.

An unauthenticated authority CLAIM about the model — never a claim
about any source, adapter, connector, or observation, and never
evidence that an observed value carries the specified unit. It
specifies value shape, nullability, and an optional model-unit
identity only: no quantity kind, no physical meaning, no limits, no
behaviour. The variable anchor is REFERENCED, not embedded: the
registration already embeds it verbatim.
VariableValueSpecification.title: VariableValueSpecification

backend__identity_binding__contracts__Au.description:
A recorded CLAIM of authorship. Nothing is authenticated or signed
in IB-001; `agent` is a claimed name and never a credential.
backend__identity_binding__contracts__Au.title: AuthorityRef

backend__model_kernel__contracts__Author.description: A recorded CLAIM of authorship — nothing is authenticated or signed.
backend__model_kernel__contracts__Author.title: AuthorityRef
